Post 1
📈 ASX 200 crossed back above its 200-day moving average Friday — closing at 8,833.60, up 69.80pts or 0.80%. Still 4.98% off the 52-week high, but momentum is building. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
IT led all sectors at +3.63%, Materials +2.26%, Energy +2.14%. Health Care dragged at -0.63%, Utilities -0.67%. Risk-on rotation in full swing. #ASX #ausbiz #tech #materials

Post 3
🔺 WiseTech Global surged 15.08% to AUD 53.87 — the single biggest driver of IT sector strength. One stock, one session, meaningful index impact. #ASX #tech #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,494.21/oz, Silver AUD 66.26/oz. With Materials up 2.26%, metals pricing is doing the heavy lifting for miners this week. #ASX #gold #silver #mining #commodities

Post 5
Index sits 4.98% below its 52-week high. Can the 200-day MA hold as support? Watch IT and Materials — if both stay bid, that gap closes fast. Where do you see the ASX by year-end? #ASX #ausbiz
